scope: Real local Temporal service, SDK Worker and PostgreSQL; not production-host integration
compositeAssertions: An actual Temporal timer survives SDK Worker shutdown and replacement
A deadline dispatch records one test SQL effect
A committed SQL effect followed by failure remains uncertain and is not repeated
A persisted rejected approval resumes the real StateGraph/PostgresSaver to rejected with no pending nodes
Duplicate committed approval is deduplicated and expired approval is rejected
Rejected approval does not invoke a provider
setupRepairs: Execute explicit test migrations through sql.begin rather than unmanaged BEGIN on a connection pool
Initialize idempotent runtime migrations even when the core task table already exists
notProven: Full Temporal server or machine restart
AWS deployment or external queue behavior
